后起的AI（人工智能）微短剧虽然迅速占领微短剧大半江山，却一直缺少具有同等影响力: Although AI (artificial intelligence) micro-short dramas, latecomers to the field, have quickly claimed most of the micro-short drama market, they have long lacked works of comparable influence.
近期，历史题材AI微短剧《持械入宋》的火爆传播，令人振奋: Recently, the viral spread of the historical-theme AI micro-short drama "Armed Entry into Song" has been heartening.
这部剧已连更11季，全系列总集数约1100集，是目前国内体量最大的历史题材AI微: The series has run for 11 consecutive seasons, with about 1,100 episodes in total, making it one of the largest historical-theme AI micro-short dramas in China today.
比热度更重要的是，该剧改变了很多人对AI微短剧的看法：角色建模已不是千人一面，表: More important than its popularity, the drama has changed many people's views of AI micro-short dramas: character modeling is no longer cut from one mold, the expression of emotions has grown increasingly mature—not to mention the obvious advantages of lifelike scenery and excellent special effects.
当然，AI技术的进步功不可没: Of course, the progress of AI technology deserves much credit.
从第九季、第十季开始，团队将主力大模型从Seedance 2.0升级到Seeda: From the ninth and tenth seasons on, the team upgraded its main large model from Seedance 2.0 to Seedance 2.5, greatly improving the texture of light and shadow in the images and the realism of AI generation, markedly enhancing expressiveness in complex motion scenes such as large-scale battles, and further improving the facial-expression management of "minor background characters."
这是AI微短剧创作最可倚仗的“械”，此“械”在手，有想法有抱负的创作者一定会层出: This is the "weapon" that AI micro-short drama creation can most rely on. With this "weapon" in hand, creators with ideas and ambition will surely emerge in an endless stream.
一般AI微短剧总是太过着急地升级打怪，不停地给主角开“外挂”，而《持械入宋》中的: Ordinary AI micro-short dramas are always too eager to level up and fight monsters, constantly giving their protagonists "cheats," whereas character progression in "Armed Entry into Song" always fits the circumstances of the time: the characters grow strong through daring to be tempered and mature through being good at learning.
5名队员每人都有自己的性格，也有属于自己的单线任务，彼此守望相助，这种长剧式的架: Each of the five team members has his own personality and his own individual storyline task, and they look out for and help one another. This long-drama-style structure is quite rare even in AI micro-short dramas, let alone in live-action ones.
其实，在AI微短剧市场，爆款并无定则，成功又岂能担保: In fact, in the AI micro-short drama market, there is no fixed formula for a hit, and how can success ever be guaranteed?
比批量成功更重要的是，AI微短剧必须尽快进入精品化发展阶段: More important than success in batches is that AI micro-short dramas must move as soon as possible into a stage of development focused on high quality.
